sections.description: The posting half of the UsefulMath pipeline (repo tedico/cross-platform-poster). Upstream: the UsefulMath approved watcher writes Content Posting Queue rows. This tab covers what happens from queue row to published post.
sections.name: Post Queue → Platforms

steps.name: Content Posting Queue row lands (Notion)
steps.notes: Written by the UsefulMath approved watcher (see the Useful Math tab). The queue is a machine state-machine DB — zero human statuses by design (data-layer contract exemption).

steps.name: Tick (GH Actions, */15) → post due rows
steps.notes: `tick.yml`: every 15 min, posts any due queue rows to the platforms (YouTube Shorts, Instagram). GitHub throttles */15 crons ~3h overnight — alarm threshold 4h by design (poster PR #8). Supports `dry_run` dispatch input. Heartbeat slug: `poster-tick` (grace 4h).

steps.name: IG token refresh (GH Actions, monthly 5th)
steps.notes: `refresh-ig-token.yml`, cron 0 9 5 ** — refreshes the Instagram access token well inside its 60-day window. Heartbeat slug: `ig-token-refresh` (grace 24h). NOTE: dispatch from main — the v1-build branch script is stale (“Missing client_id” = old code, not expired creds).

sections.description: Same dead-man's-switch layer as UsefulMath (added 2026-07-24): both workflows and the watchdog ping healthchecks.io; a missing ping is the alarm.
sections.name: Monitoring

steps.name: Poster watchdog (Zo, hourly :30) — transitional
steps.notes: Zo automation `cc1af1e5`: pull-based health check of the tick workflows + Post Queue. Retiring with the other pull-based watchdogs after the heartbeat system delivers a clean week. Heartbeat slug: `poster-watchdog` (grace 30m).

steps.name: Heartbeats → healthchecks.io (3 checks)
steps.notes: `poster-tick`, `ig-token-refresh`, `poster-watchdog` — registry + schedules live in the UsefulMath repo: `scripts/hc_provision.py::CHECKS`. Down/fail → email + Telegram + GitHub issue in tedico/useful-math.

tools.name: Instagram
tools.notes: Posting target of cross-platform-poster. Access token auto-refreshed monthly by `refresh-ig-token.yml` (heartbeat slug `ig-token-refresh`).

tools.name: Descript
tools.notes: **FIRED 2026-07-21** — replaced by the in-repo KM-engine (ffmpeg + ElevenLabs on Zo, `src/assemble/`): ~$0.35/video vs $600/yr. Kept here for history.
